class.name: ProgressBarStyle
class.brief_description: The shared look of world-space bars drawn by [ProgressBarServer].

members.member: The [StyleBox] drawn behind the fill, over the whole bar. If [code]null[/code], the [code skip-lint]background[/code] theme item of [ProgressBar] is used (project theme first, then the default theme).

The [StyleBox] drawn for the filled part. Like [ProgressBar], the fill keeps the minimum size of this [StyleBox] and is not drawn at ratio [code]0.0[/code]. If [code]null[/code], the [code skip-lint]fill[/code] theme item of [ProgressBar] is used.
The direction in which the bar fills, see [enum ProgressBar.FillMode]. There is no right-to-left mirroring in world space.
How the bar follows its parent's transform.
If [code]true[/code], bars with ratio [code]0.0[/code] are hidden.
If [code]true[/code], bars with ratio [code]1.0[/code] are hidden, for example health bars of unhurt units.
The center of the bar in the parent's local space (for example above the unit). It is added to the offset set with [method ProgressBarServer.bar_set_offset].
The size of the bar in pixels, in the parent's local space.

constants.constant: The bar inherits the full transform of its parent: it moves, rotates and scales with the unit. This costs nothing per frame.
The bar follows only the position of its parent and stays upright and unscaled when the unit rotates or scales. The server updates these bars once per frame.
Represents the size of the [enum FollowMode] enum.
